svg.title: Kubernetes and AKS lab 2 — planned architecture
svg.desc: Planned two-node AKS Free learning cluster with an application Pod and in-cluster client. Three faults teach scheduling, ConfigMap references and Service target ports. No cloud resources have been deployed.

g.text: Planned Azure profile · Learn Sub 1 · East US · local kind rehearsal also supported
No ACR or custom image build
One web Pod + one small client Pod
Public, digest-pinned Python image · standard-library app mounted from a ConfigMap
Same workload and faults on kind
Deployment strategy: Recreate · one app replica · reset and verify baseline before each fault
1 Scheduling / Pending · 2 Configuration / startup · 3 Service routing
Custom learning architecture · Microsoft Azure icons · planning profile only; quota and deployment validation remain pending
